release_notes: Meet EniStream: the app is now EniStream with a new name, purple launcher icon and splash. Upgraded to production Clerk sign-in, plus Privacy Policy and Terms of Service links in Profile. Also includes: watch button always plays, movies play directly with no episode section, series open episode 1 with selectable episodes, collapsible synopsis (read more/less), and episodes batched 1-100 / 101-200 for smooth scrolling on long series.
